'''Fellon base''' was a hidden [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fellon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].

==History==
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Wraith Squadron]] disguised as the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]] launched an attack on Fellon base as part of [[Halmad campaign|Operation Groundquake]]. The Wraiths were surprised when the base suddenly activated its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and three squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|Interceptors]] flew out and engaged the Wraiths.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
